install.notes: setup.py:5-15 installs only the top-level dronesim package and requires numpy, scipy, Pillow, matplotlib, cycler, gym and pybullet. The gate and the fake backend need none of them: fake.py is pure Python, and package code never imports the clone. Install the upstream only to serve the real PyBullet environment, which this package does not offer (no registered gym id; backends serve fake only).
